label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_01
text: You already faced me during the Elite Test, so...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_02
text: I doubt this will leave much of an impression\non you. In any case, let’s get started, shall we?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_03
text: I’ll be facing you in my role as a Gym Leader,\nso I’m going to use my regular team.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_04
text: They all belong to the Normal type.\c\n“Normal” as in plain...average...unremarkable...\nrun-of-the-mill...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_05
text: I’m pretty fond of them, you know? They suit me\nperfectly—I’m about as ordinary as you can get.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_06
text: People, Pokémon... There’s no need to\novercomplicate things.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_07
text: Nowadays people only seem to want a shock\nfactor. Something weird, something bizarre.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_08
text: At the end of the day, though, nothing beats the\nrelief of coming home, even after a fun vacation.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_09
text: When all’s said and done, simplicity is strongest.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_10
text: You’re a bit too much for an average joe like me\nto handle...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_11
text: But I think I understand now.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_12
text: Why I was told to use Flying types when I battle\nas a member of the Elite Four, I mean.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_13
text: There’s scenery you’ll never even notice if you\nstick to flat, well-trodden paths.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_14
text: It’ll do me good to admire talent that soars as\nhigh as yours from time to time.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_15
text: Well, if the boss says I should do so, I’ll do so.\nShe won’t catch me doing it for fun, though.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: common_2020_normal_020_normal_16
text: In any case, I’ve been strictly told to cut down on\nmy overtime hours, so...I’ll call it a day.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]
